source.attribution: Beck et al. (2023), High-resolution (1 km) Köppen-Geiger maps for 1901–2099 based on constrained CMIP6 projections, Scientific Data 10, 724, doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02549-6
source.modifications: Nearest-neighbour resampled to 1/12 degree; Köppen–Geiger classes mapped to UHS climate labels: Af/Aw tropical, Am monsoon, BW and BSh arid, BSk temperate (dry), Cs Mediterranean, other C temperate, warm-summer D temperate, cold-summer D boreal, E tundra. A coarse moisture tier is retained for visual ecology blending.
